---
name: ELLA app architecture
description: Key decisions and patterns for the ELLA AI personal companion app
---

## Stack
- Frontend: React+Vite at `/` (artifacts/chatbot)
- Backend: Express 5 at `/api` (artifacts/api-server)
- DB: Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL, schema in lib/db/src/schema/

## Auth
- Session-less demo auth: POST /api/auth/login returns `{ userId, username, token }` 
- Client stores `{ userId, username }` in localStorage key `ella_user` via AuthContext
- No JWT library used — token is `mock-token-{userId}`, not validated server-side

## API Zod schema names (generated by orval — NOT the names you'd guess)
- Use `RegisterBody`, `LoginBody` (not `AuthInput`)
- Use `ListXxxQueryParams` (not `ListXxxParams`) for GET query params
- Use `CreateXxxBody` (not `XxxInput`) for POST bodies
- Use `UpdateXxxBody` (not `XxxUpdate`) for PATCH bodies
- UnlogHabit DELETE: `/habits/:id/log/:date` — params parsed manually (no zod schema)

## Conversations table
- Template schema was missing userId — added `userId integer not null default 0` column
- Always filter conversations by userId when listing

## Seeded demo user
- username: demo, password: demo123, userId: 1
- 3 journal entries, 4 habits with logs, 3 goals, 3 mood logs

## AI routes
- Chat: POST /api/openai/conversations/:id/messages — SSE stream, injects last 10 journal entries as context
- Meditation: POST /api/meditation/session — SSE stream, generates narration script
- Model: gpt-5.6-terra for chat, gpt-5.6-luna for meditation

**Why:** These decisions were made during initial build; future changes should preserve the localStorage auth pattern and SSE streaming approach.
